description: This file defines the NodePairingApprovalPrompter responsible for managing node pairing approval prompts in a macOS application. It handles loading pending pairing requests, presenting alerts, managing user responses, automatic approvals via SSH, and synchronizing state with a backend gateway. The class employs asynchronous tasks and observer patterns to maintain the pairing prompt lifecycle and ensure the UI reflects the current pairing state.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages user prompts for node pairing requests, including loading requests from a gateway, presenting UI alerts, handling user responses, and updating the pairing state asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the pairing prompt process, including loading pending requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing tasks related to pairing prompts, clears state, and cancels alerts.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pending pairing requests from the backend gateway, with retries on failure.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Periodically synchronizes pairing requests with the backend to stay in sync across multiple instances.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a list of pairing requests and updates the UI and internal state accordingly.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pairing prompt if none are currently being presented.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays a user prompt for a pairing request, allowing the user to approve or reject.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles the user's response to a pairing prompt and updates the backend accordingly.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts an automatic silent approval of a pairing request via SSH if conditions allow.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a local notification about the result of a pairing approval or rejection.

methods.name: resolveSSHTarget
methods.description: Resolves SSH target information, either from configuration or via network discovery.

methods.name: probeSSH
methods.description: Performs an SSH connection test to verify reachability for silent approval.
